title: MembershipChanged
description: Published by Auth & Users to farol.auth-users with routing key membership.changed, through the outbox (ADR-004), whenever a membership of an event changes: its teams (US-18), and later its creation (US-06, US-12) and its role (US-15). Consumed from events.auth-users-events, reports.auth-users-events and transports.auth-users-events: each service keeps the copy it decides permissions from, and refuses a non-member (API outline 1.5, 7.3, 7.4; US-14). Full state with a version (7.3): every change carries the role and every team the member is in, so a consumer upserts its copy and ignores a version that is not newer than the one it has. eventId is the event the membership belongs to — the first event type of this service that has one. status is Active while MembershipStatus stands (#198); a membership that no longer exists is a row this service deletes. AMQP properties as GlobalRoleChanged, with type = MembershipChanged.

teamIds.description: Every live team of this event the member is in, sorted; empty when they are in none
